summary: Targeted retest for floating annotation (.evidence-float) overlap with Nova state buttons on /preview/dark and /preview/light. Measured geometry at 1920/1440/768/390/320px widths. Annotation sits fully below all three state pills (Listening/Thinking/Speaking) on both concepts at every breakpoint. No horizontal overflow. No collision with .visual-footnote. State buttons clickable without force; caption and current-state update correctly for all three states on both concepts. Concept switcher (switch-dark, switch-light) present and interactive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Annotation overlap fix verified. CSS override using position:relative + margin:-8px 0 0 auto places .evidence-float fully below all Nova state buttons at every tested breakpoint (320-1920) on both /preview/dark and /preview/light. No regressions in state-click interactivity or concept switcher. No console errors.
